result.summary: The image shows a narrow urban street with sidewalks on both sides and a faded marked crosswalk at a stop-controlled intersection. While the street geometry suggests low speeds, the presence of parked cars near the corner and degraded pavement markings reduce pedestrian visibility and safety.

hazards.name: Faded Crosswalk Markings
hazards.description: The painted crosswalk is significantly worn and degraded, making it less visible to approaching motorists.

hazards.name: Sightline Obstruction from Parked Vehicles
hazards.description: Vehicles parked close to the intersection corner may block the view between pedestrians waiting to cross and approaching drivers.
hazards.location_in_image: Right and left curbsides near the intersection

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalk Markings
interventions.description: Repaint the crossing with high-visibility continental or ladder patterns to improve driver awareness.

interventions.title: Intersection Daylighting
interventions.description: Restrict parking within 20-30 feet of the crosswalk to ensure clear sightlines between all road users.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk at the corners to shorten the crossing distance and physically prevent parking in the daylighting zone.

result.summary: The image depicts a narrow urban street with multi-story brick buildings and sidewalks on both sides. The environment lacks marked pedestrian crossings and features significant visual obstructions due to parked vehicles along the curb, which complicates safe crossing.

hazards.name: Visual Obstructions

hazards.name: Sidewalk Encroachment
hazards.description: A scooter and other items are parked on the narrow sidewalk, reducing the effective width for pedestrians.

result.summary: The image shows a narrow urban street with a sidewalk on the left but a complete lack of pedestrian crossing infrastructure at the foreground corner. There are no marked crosswalks, curb ramps, or traffic control devices visible to manage the interaction between pedestrians and vehicles.

hazards.name: Lack of marked crosswalk
hazards.description: Pedestrians crossing at the intersection have no designated space, increasing exposure to vehicles.

hazards.name: Lack of curb ramps
hazards.description: The vertical curb at the corner creates an accessibility barrier for people with mobility aids or strollers.

hazards.name: Uncontrolled intersection
hazards.description: No stop signs or signals are visible to regulate traffic flow at the corner.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental-style marked crosswalks to clearly define pedestrian right-of-way.

interventions.title: ADA Curb Ramps
interventions.description: Install tactile, sloped curb ramps at the corner to ensure the sidewalk is accessible to all users.

interventions.title: Traffic Control Signage
interventions.description: Install stop signs or yield signs to regulate vehicle movement at the intersection.
